notes: tokenizer.ggml.pre='qwen2' is assumed for Qwen3.5; measured against the HF tokenizer in the round-trip receipt rather than trusted
250 embedding rows had no tokenizer entry and were written as [PAD*] placeholders
4096 ledger band rows written as CONTROL tokens
the GGUF is f16 and the HF reference runs in its native bf16 on different kernels; the two are not expected to be bit-identical and no threshold is asserted here
generation uses the same token id list on both sides, so tokenizer disagreement is reported separately and cannot be mistaken for model disagreement
tokenizer.ggml.pre='qwen2' is an assumption about the pre-tokenizer regex; the per-prompt tokenizer_agrees flag is the measurement of it

top5_ids_agree compares ORDER; bf16 produces exact ties in the reference (e.g. two ids at the same probability) that the two runtimes order differently, so top5_id_set_agrees is the comparison that is about the candidates
